content: {"episode_id":"ep-05092","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-50","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-50 medical necessity denial for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229). The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes."}
